input.query: optional240 UTF-16 units; wins over q alias

operations.normalization: Shared optionalString trims then slices; clampInt uses finite numeric coercion/truncation. Owner normalizes page/limit again. Do not silently expose extra ListPersonnelDto selectors pe_aligned/sort/include_superseded: Meri wrapper does not pass them.
operations.querySemantics: withTenant callback; default excludes supersededAt nonnull. Exact service/role; organization contains case-insensitively; PE primary equality or secondary has. Nonempty trimmed q invokes fuzzy SQL ID lookup with page skip and take before remaining row filters; orderByIds restores ID rank.
operations.countCaveat: With q, total is the length of the already paged fuzzy ID array, not all matches; later filters may reduce data further. Without q, total comes from model count. Do not infer full count, hasMore or terminal absence from fuzzy total.

row.title: string|null
row.email: stored string|null ONLY for exact current ctx.role capiro_admin; otherwise null
row.headshotUrl: metadata object field headshotUrl or null; source does not check the field value type

operations.dtoLimits: List DTO additionally declares optional roles/crmLinkBlocked/crmLinkBlockedReason; this Meri-used owner projection does not produce them. DTO headshotUrl string|null is stronger than actual metadata passthrough; a typed output refusal for malformed scalar needs explicit documentation, not invented string conversion.

input.id: required trimmed string capped80 by source helper; underlying identity column UUID

operations.privacy: No separate email/headshotUrl top-level fields in detail projection; opaque metadata and source metadata remain in the producer. Treat as untrusted reported data, not authority; do not silently claim those JSON bodies have no personal/contact values.
operations.bounds: Sources ordered observedAt descending, no producer take/continuation cap. Canonical inert JSON/output budgets may refuse oversize; do not invent a complete truncated page.
operations.notFound: Owner throws NotFoundException after its withTenant callback; no successful person:null branch is established.

effect.missingRecord: Audit call is unconditional in callback before the outer not-found throw.

authority: Meri authenticated TenantContext/request-control entry; both methods receive ctx and owner uses withTenant. Email admission is exact equality to capiro_admin, not arbitrary privileged-role inference or model option. Models have no tenantId field; withTenant establishes execution/audit context rather than a demonstrated tenant-private row partition. Future gateway current authority and privacy projection must be trusted and rechecked.
effectsAndQualification: These are source-readable contracts, not effect-free adapter calls. Both audit inserts are awaited with no local try/catch; errors propagate. Fuzzy lookup performs stored SELECT via tx.$queryRaw; no ingestion/provider/network call identified in these owner paths. Qualify audit transaction, current actor/role, budgets and error behavior before any handler activation; do not remove audit writes silently or mislabel them missing DTOs.
